jobs.description: Job Description We zijn op zoek naar een positieve en proactieve professional die moeiteloos schakelt tussen beleid, uitvoering en operatie. Voor onze Animal Health locatie Boxmeer zoeken wij een Maintenance Support Engineer Welkom in ons team Onze Animal Health site in Boxmeer is de grootste locatie binnen ons wereldwijde diergezondheidsnetwerk en richt zich op onderzoek, ontwikkeling en productie van diergezondheidsproducten volgens de normen van Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP). Wij ondersteunen een drietal producerende afdelingen op het gebied van onderhoud en projecten. De afdelingen produceren geïnactiveerde vaccins en Pharmaceutische producten volgens strikte GMP-normen in steriele bereidings- en afvulfaciliteiten. Je komt terecht in een gedreven team van circa 14 collega’s, waar samenwerking en kennisdeling centraal staan. Het team bestaat uit een mooie mix van specialisten: 6 tot 7 technicians die dagelijks zorgen dat alles blijft draaien, 4 werkvoorbereiders die structuur en planning brengen, een andere Maintenance Support Engineer (MSE) die meedenkt over verbeteringen en ontwikkeling, en een technisch administratief medewerker die het geheel ondersteunt. Samen vormen jullie een team waarin ervaring, praktische kennis en ambitie samenkomen. Er is volop ruimte om te leren, bij te dragen en mee te bouwen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de afdeling. Over de functie Als Maintenance Support Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de efficiënte voorbereiding, coördinatie en uitvoering van complexe onderhoudswerkzaamheden aan productie-installaties, utilities, HVAC-systemen en randapparatuur. Je speelt een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van installaties, in lijn met productie-, veiligheids- (SHE) en bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Waar de Maintenance & Reliability Engineer bepaalt wat er moet gebeuren, ben jij verantwoordelijk voor hoe dit wordt uitgevoerd. Het is een dynamische rol waarin operationele aansturing, stakeholdermanagement en continue verbetering samenkomen. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden VertegenwoordeiVoorbereiden, coördineren en begeleiden van complexe onderhoudswerkzaamheden (incl. shutdowns en projecten) Optimalisatie onderhoudsstrategieën en initieren en uitvoeren van verbeterinitiatieven Afstemmen en plannen van werkzaamheden met productie en andere stakeholders Opstellen van werkvergunningen, LOTO-procedures en risicoanalyses (TRA) Input in risicoanalyses (PHA) en procesoptimalisaties Bewaken van planning, kwaliteit, veiligheid en budget Ondersteunen en optimaliseren van SAP Plant Maintenance (key user) Zorgen voor compliance met relevante wet- en regelgeving (o.a. PED, SHE, GxP) Aanspreekpunt voor leveranciers, contractors en externe partijen Bijdragen aan continue verbeteringen binnen de maintenance organisatie Coachen en begeleiden van collega’s waar nodig Vertegenwoordigen van de onderhoudsafdeling bij nieuwbouw- en modificatieprojecten Rapporteren, documenteren en beheren van KPI’s en onderhoudsdata Jouw profiel HBO-diploma in een technische richting of MBO+ met relevante werkervaring Ervaring in maintenance, engineering of een vergelijkbare omgeving Kennis van onderhoudsprocessen, planning en werkvergunningen Ervaring met SAP PM of vergelijkbare systemen is een pre Bekend met veiligheidsnormen en regelgeving (bijv. NEN, ISO, GxP) Technische kennis van bijvoorbeeld HVAC, utilities of procesinstallaties is een pre Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels (mondeling en schriftelijk) Wij bieden Je komt terecht in een open, divers en collegiaal team. De rol biedt een zeer breed en divers werkveld met veel variatie in projecten op een groeiende site met meer dan 2000 medewerkers waar meerdere productiefaciliteiten, laboratoria, installaties en gebouwen in alle levensfasen samenkomen, van historische systemen tot state-of-the-art nieuwbouw. Verder kun je rekenen op: Competitief salaris afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. 3% eindejaarsuitkering en een jaarlijkse bonus op basis van eigen en bedrijfsresultaten. Minimaal 35,5 verlofdagen. Reiskostenvergoeding en een solide pensioenregeling. Een hoogwaardig bedrijfsrestaurant met dagelijks verse en gezonde opties. Uitstekende bereikbaarheid: het treinstation ligt direct bij onze hoofdingang en er is ruime parkeergelegenheid. Een bijdrage aan je persoonlijke sportabonnement ter ondersteuning van je vitaliteit. Een prachtig privépark op het terrein, ideaal voor een wandeling, pauze of moment van ontspanning. Mentale welzijnsondersteuning via Lyra Health voor jou en je gezinsleden. Toegang tot een aparte gebeds-/meditatieruimte. Uitgebreide doorgroeimogelijkheden dankzij de omvang van de site en de aanwezigheid van vele disciplines en global afdelingen die in Boxmeer vertegenwoordigd zijn. Een werkplek binnen een organisatie die continu groeit en zich door ontwikkelt. Animal Health Onze Animal Health divisie is een vertrouwde wereldleider in veterinaire geneeskunde, gewijd aan het behoud en verbeteren van de gezondheid, het welzijn en de prestaties van dieren en de mensen die voor hen zorgen. Wij zijn een wereldwijd team van professionals dat samenwerkt om een positieve impact te maken in de dierenzorg en de voedselvoorziening in de wereld, en we hebben een diep gevoel van verantwoordelijkheid naar onze klanten, consumenten, dieren, de samenleving en onze planeet. Door onze toewijding aan The Science of Healthier Animals® bieden wij dierenartsen, boeren, huisdiereigenaren en overheden een van de breedste assortimenten aan veterinaire geneesmiddelen, vaccins en oplossingen en diensten voor gezondheidsbeheer, evenals een uitgebreid aanbod van digitaal verbonden identificatie-, traceer- en monitoringsproducten. We investeren in dynamische en uitgebreide R&D-middelen en een moderne, wereldwijde toeleveringsketen. We zijn actief in meer dan 50 landen, terwijl onze producten beschikbaar zijn in ongeveer 150 markten. Heb je vragen over deze vacature? Job Description: Sales Professional SMB (d/w/m) – General Sales Wer wir sind: Bei Ingram Micro glauben wir an eine technologische Zukunft mit faszinierenden neuen Möglichkeiten. Wir sind das Bindeglied zwischen Hersteller und Fachhandel im Bereich Informations- und Telekommunikationstechnologie. Dabei agieren wir eher im Hintergrund, doch ohne uns würden viele Produkte und Lösungen den Weg zum Endkunden nicht finden. Dein neues Team – General Sales: Unsere Vision ist klar: Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern nachhaltiges Wachstum im Small- und Midmarket-Segment zu schaffen. Unsere Mission dabei? Die richtigen Technologien mit den passenden Kunden zusammenzubringen und Partner dabei zu unterstützen, ihr Geschäft erfolgreich auszubauen. Genau daran arbeiten wir jeden Tag gemeinsam. Unser Team verbindet Vertriebsstärke, Technologieverständnis und Kundenfokus in einem leistungsorientierten und kollegialen Umfeld. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, teilen Wissen, feiern gemeinsame Erfolge und übernehmen Verantwortung für unsere Ergebnisse. So leisten wir jeden Tag einen direkten Beitrag zum Wachstum unserer Partner und zum Erfolg von Ingram Micro. Deine Mission - let‘s shape tomorrow! Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter, identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und unterstützt unsere Partner dabei, nachhaltig erfolgreich zu wachsen. Mit deinem Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse, deiner Neugier und deiner Hands-on-Mentalität schaffst du die Grundlage für langfristigen Vertriebserfolg und starke Partnerschaften. Dein typischer Arbeitsalltag kann so aussehen: Du betreust und entwickelst Kunden im Small- und Midmarket-Segment und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du arbeitest eng mit Partnern zusammen und unterstützt beim Aufbau neuer Geschäftsbeziehungen. Du entwickelst dich im Vertrieb kontinuierlich weiter und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung in der Betreuung von Kunden und Accounts. Du identifizierst Kundenbedürfnisse, erkennst Geschäftschancen und erschließt Wachstumspotenziale. Du arbeitest an Forecasts, Angeboten und Präsentationen mit und entwickelst deine Sales-Skills kontinuierlich weiter. Das macht dich aus: Deine Arbeitsweise: Du hast Freude am Vertrieb, gehst Themen proaktiv an und baust gerne Beziehungen auf. Dabei bist du neugierig, lernbereit und entwickelst dich kontinuierlich weiter. Du arbeitest strukturiert, erkennst Chancen und setzt Prioritäten zielgerichtet. Dein Erfahrungsschatz: Du bringst erste Erfahrungen im Vertrieb, Kundenkontakt oder Business-Umfeld mit oder verfügst bereits über fundierte Sales-Erfahrung. Interesse an Hard- und Softwarelösungen sowie am SMB-Umfeld zeichnet dich aus. Soft Skills: Du kommunizierst offen und professionell, erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und verstehst es, vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufzubauen. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du lösungsorientiert und gerne im Team. Sprachkenntnisse: Da wir im Team Deutsch sprechen, solltest du Sprachkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau mitbringen. Für die Zusammenarbeit mit Herstellern und internationalen Ansprechpartnern sind gute Englischkenntnisse wichtig. Mobilität: Offenheit für Kundentermine, Partnertreffen und Veranstaltungen bringst du selbstverständlich mit. Nice to have: Erste Berührungspunkte mit IT-Produkten sowie Erfahrungen im SMB-Umfeld oder indirekten Vertrieb sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Räumliche Nähe: Bei dieser Position freuen wir uns auf deine regelmäßige Präsenz im Büro in Dornach bei München. Mit unserem hybriden Arbeitsmodell bleibt deine Arbeitsgestaltung trotzdem flexibel. Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100%? Kein Problem – wir freuen uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Uns ist wichtig, dass du Lernbereitschaft, Neugier und Motivation mitbringst. Das sind unsere Benefits für dich: Weiterentwicklung: Fundierte Einarbeitung, individuelle Entwicklungspläne, Mentorship, fachliche und persönliche Weiterbildung. Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Modell (3 Tage Büro-Anwesenheit, 2 Tage Homeoffice), 30 Urlaubstage + Mental Health Day, mobiles Arbeiten im EU-Ausland, 38,5h Vertrauensarbeitszeit. Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Abhängig vom Standort stehen dir verschiedene Angebote für Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden zur Verfügung. Zusätzliche Vorteile: Bezuschusste Kantine, kostenlose Getränke, Mitarbeiterrabatte, Altersvorsorge, Bike- & Technikleasing sowie e-Ladestationen. Vergütung: Wo du innerhalb der Gehaltsspanne für diese Rolle startest, hängt von objektiven, festen Kriterien ab. Alles Weitere rund um Vergütung und Rahmenbedingungen klären wir transparent im persönlichen Austausch im Erstgespräch. Dein Erfolg bei Ingram Micro: Ingram Micro investiert in die Zukunft der MitarbeiterInnen. Durch Lernpfade, Weiterbildungen und persönliche Entwicklungspläne sowie Ziele. Ein Großteil unserer Beförderungen erfolgt aus den eigenen Reihen, da es uns ein zentrales Anliegen ist, internes Talent gezielt zu fördern. Your ambition empowers tomorrow's technology, today. Besuche uns gerne auch auf unserer Karriereseite und auf LinkedIn . #LI-GZ1

jobs.description: At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it. Position Summary Are you looking for an opportunity to gain experience in BioPharma while gaining leadership exposure, career mentorship, and making an impact on work that matters? The 10-week internship program at Bristol Myers Squibb’s growing state of the art Biologics campus in Devens, MA is the ultimate career experience! The program includes formal and informal networking, development, and mentorship of participants with a focus on building and advancing professional skills in the BioPharma industry. This internship is a site-focused Supply Chain position supporting the Cell Therapy Facility (CTF) at the BMS-Devens campus. The intern will work alongside the CTF Supply Chain team to evaluate current-state material storage and movement processes, from material receipt through delivery to end users, to help the site achieve higher storage capacity and optimal throughput as CTF aligns with new automated technologies in supply chain and manufacturing. Specific areas of focus include: Cell Therapy Facility (CTF) – Supply Chain Evaluating current-state material storage and movement requirements, from receipt through delivery to end users within CTF, to enable higher storage capacity and optimal throughput aligned with automated supply chain and manufacturing technologies Defining storage capacity and requirements for the materials used throughout CTF Building hands-on skills in capacity analysis, material flow and usage, cell therapy processing, and internal material logistics This project will be defined with key deliverables and provide the candidate with opportunities to develop new skills and work directly on key aspects of the business. Example deliverables include a current-state assessment of CTF material storage and movement, a documented capacity and requirements analysis for CTF materials, and recommendations to support the facility's alignment with automated supply chain and manufacturing technologies. This full-time ten-week internship program will take place June through August of 2027. Please ensure that you can support a full-time work schedule (40 hours per week, 5 days per week M-F) for this position. Key Responsibilities Examples of Key Responsibilities: Evaluate current-state material storage and movement within the Cell Therapy Facility, mapping material flow from receipt through delivery to end users Define storage capacity and requirements for the materials used throughout CTF, and identify gaps between current and needed capacity Collect, organize, and analyze material usage and throughput data using tools such as Excel, Power BI, and/or SAP to support capacity and process recommendations Partner cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Facilities teams to understand current material logistics and align on future-state requirements Support efforts to align CTF storage and material movement with new automated technologies being deployed in supply chain and manufacturing Document findings and present recommendations and proposed process improvements to project stakeholders Qualifications & Experience Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's (third-year or above) or Master's program in Supply Chain, Life Sciences, Engineering or related field Interest and passion for BioPharma and biotechnology Experience or coursework in data mining and analytics, such as AI-based tools, Power BI, and/or Excel Familiarity with ERP systems, SAP preferred, and exposure to project management or other proven organizational methods Strong communication skills, with experience working in a highly collaborative environment and the ability to work effectively in a team Strong analytical skills as demonstrated through previous experience, which may include project design coursework, research projects, laboratory or manufacturing experience, and/or previous co-ops/internships; candidates seeking to learn more about cell therapy manufacturing, supply chain operations, or manufacturing support roles are encouraged to apply All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and for the duration of their employment. jobs.description: About the Team The Frontier Assurance team brings independent scrutiny into OpenAI’s safety decisions and helps the public understand and assess our safety work. We lead third-party assessments and safeguard testing for OpenAI’s flagship launches, pilot new assurance mechanisms such as embedded auditing, run our misalignment disclosure process, and incorporate independent expert input as evidence for critical safety decisions. About the Role As a Research Program Manager on the Frontier Assurance team, you will build programs that bring independent expertise into frontier AI safety decisions and make the evidence behind those decisions understandable to the public. You will lead external research partnerships and third-party assessments, coordinate public safety documentation, and develop new approaches to independent scrutiny and transparency. Working across research, engineering, product, policy, and communications, you will help ensure external findings inform concrete decisions and that our public explanations accurately reflect the evidence, limitations, and remaining uncertainty. We’re looking for people with deep experience in research partnerships and program management with technical and research teams. This role combines partnership management, cross-functional coordination, an understanding of AI safety research, alignment, and evaluations, and strong communication skills. You will work with researchers and engineers within OpenAI and across the external community to initiate projects, set ambitious goals and milestones, and drive execution across multiple teams. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role, you will: - Design and run third-party assessment programs for frontier models and safeguards, including independent evaluations, adversarial testing, and new approaches such as embedded auditing. Work with researchers and external partners to define assessment questions, scope, access, timelines, and deliverables. - Build and manage strategic research partnerships with third-party evaluators, academic labs, and other independent experts, prioritizing expertise, independence, and diversity of perspectives. Enable rigorous research, including work that challenges internal assumptions. - Bring external findings to safety decision-makers and translate them into actionable recommendations for safeguards, deployment, product, and policy. Track follow-up actions and ensure partners understand how their input was considered. - Partner with research, product, policy, and communications teams to explain the evidence behind OpenAI’s safety approach: what we tested, what we learned, how findings shaped safeguards and deployment decisions, and where limitations and uncertainty remain. Translate complex technical results into accurate, accessible communication for expert and public audiences. - Lead public transparency programs, including system cards, summaries of third-party assessments, and updates on significant findings and follow-up actions. Develop approaches to sharing methods, results, and limitations while protecting privacy, security, and sensitive information. - Create channels for researchers and civil society to ask questions, provide feedback, and inform future assessments and transparency efforts, including beyond individual launches. - Own program goals, milestones, dependencies, and risks across assessment and transparency work, keeping internal and external stakeholders informed and resolving obstacles to execution. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have an understanding of AI evaluations and measurement, and can engage with technical teams on evaluation design and results. - Can interpret evaluation findings and communicate what they do and do not establish, including methodological limitations, uncertainty, and disagreement. - Have experience building research partnerships and managing external stakeholders, especially academic researchers and independent experts. - Can synthesize technical and social science research into clear executive summaries and accessible explanations for public audiences. - Have experience delivering technical publications or public reports across multiple contributors, and exercising judgment about what to share, with whom, and when. - Have worked cross-functionally across product, research, and engineering teams and can coordinate complex programs with policy and communications partners. - Have an understanding of and interest in frontier AI safety and policy. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. WHAT MAKES US EPIC?
At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.
Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.
PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE
What We Do
Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.
What You'll Do
Epic Games is seeking an experienced Senior Language Programmer to join our Verse team, which owns the toolchain (compiler, VM, and runtime) that powers game development in Unreal Engine and UEFN. You'll work on the systems every UE and UEFN developer relies on to build and ship games with Verse.
In this role, you will
Extend, evolve, and maintain the Verse compiler toolchain, transactional memory runtime and VM, add new platform support, implement new language features and integrate with Unreal Engine's content, build, and cooking pipelines
Optimize performance, memory usage, and iteration times across the Verse toolchain, runtime and UE/Verse boundary
Work closely with language consumers to ensure an exceptional user experience
Establish test workflows to validate improvements and prevent regressions
Design and maintain the scripting interface to Unreal Engine, working in close collaboration with the Verse Language team and the broader UE organization
What we're looking for
Expert knowledge of C++17 or later
Experience in compiler or toolchain development (e.g., compiler internals, VM design, Clang/LLVM, or linker/platform ABI specifics)
Experience developing and optimizing large codebases, with the ability to make tradeoffs between usability, performance, and power
Strong ability to reason about large, interconnected systems
Solid grounding in software programming principles, including API design
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work autonomously and deliver practical solutions
Experience with Unreal Engine integration is a plus
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE
We pay 100% for benefits for both employees and dependents and offer coverage for supplemental medical, dental, vision, critical illness, telemedicine, Life and AD&D, long term disability insurance as well as weekly indemnity (short term disability) and a retirement savings plan with a competitive employer match. 쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
조직 소개
본 직무는 Coupang Ads 조직의 백엔드 개발자로서 쿠팡 광고 플랫폼의 새로운 기능을 개발 및 설계하는 역할을 수행하게 됩니다. 쿠팡은 세계 최고 수준의 광고 비즈니스를 구축하기 위한 투자를 하고 있으며, 쿠팡 웹사이트 및 모바일 앱 상에 위치한 주요 구좌에 연관성 있는 광고를 운영하고 있습니다. Coupang Ads 조직은 쿠팡의 판매자 및 공급자에게 셀프서비스 광고 운영 기능을 제공함으로써 쿠팡의 광고 솔루션을 보다 성장시키기 위한 차세대 프로덕트 및 서비스를 개발 중에 있습니다.
Coupang Ads 조직은 쿠팡의 광고 상품을 구현할 수 있는 시스템과 인프라를 개발할 열정적인 소프트웨어 개발자를 찾고 있습니다. 본 직무에는 그린필드 프로젝트 개발과 낮은 레이턴시 및 고가용성(availability) 서비스, 확장가능한 시스템, 프로그래매틱 연동을 위한 API 개발이 포함됩니다. 또한, 풀기 어려운 문제를 파악 및 해결하여 시스템의 확장성(scalability)과 신뢰성(reliability)을 향상시키는 작업과 효율적인 리소스 운영도 요구됩니다.
낮은 레이턴시와 높은 확장성을 갖춘 분산 서비스 개발에 관심이 있으신 분, 세계 최고 수준의 쿠팡 광고 비즈니스 구축이라는 큰 기회의 일원이 되고 싶으신 분, Coupang Ads 조직은 이러한 서비스를 함께 개발할 리더를 찾고 있습니다.

당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위 2항 본문에 따라 채용서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용서류 반환청구서[채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제3호 서식]를 작성하여 당사 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위 2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180일 간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

jobs.description: The opportunity Unity is shipping AI products into the hands of millions of creators, and the data infrastructure behind Unity’s Grow business is being rebuilt at the same time. When does a telemetry default cross from convenience into a consent problem? You will not be applying a playbook. You will be writing it, and your written positions will govern how products get built. Longer-term success: Unity’s AI and data-use positions are coherent across the portfolio rather than negotiated product by product; the frameworks scale without you personally reviewing every request; you are a trusted voice with product and engineering leadership on what Unity should and should not do.
